decision: Defer scanner scheduling changes: the bounded feasibility prototype saved only about 12 ms with overlapping ranges. Retain the benchmark and Debug diagnostics.

environment.cache_state: warm/uncontrolled; no cache flushing or background-load isolation

fixture_shapes.wide: 200000 empty ASCII files in one directory
fixture_shapes.fanout: 2000 directories with 100 empty ASCII files each

release_method: Six blocks per shape, fresh first and immediate repeat processes. Odd blocks request cancellation after 50 ms; even blocks request it 1 ms after observing finalization fraction at least 0.1. Each cancellation probe is a separate scan after the measured complete scan in its process.
diagnostic_method: Release optimization with -Xswiftc -DDEBUG in a separate scratch build; three profiles per shape, each preceded by a diagnostics-disabled warm-up. Operation totals sum worker intervals and can overlap.
prototype_method: Six balanced staged/overlap pairs, each variant preceded by its own fresh-process warm-up. Five preparation tasks maximum, native batch granularity, retained source batches until success, no complete tree or global commit/summary work. Validation-only process checks late native unavailability and cancellation.
validation: Release counts, bytes, zero warnings, tree and semantic fingerprints agree for each shape. Diagnostic tree fingerprints and counts match Release. All 25 prototype processes match 200000 unique IDs and the same path fingerprint, with URL/name consistency checks. Both provisional-result failure checks pass.
